messages:
emma_cs: quick heads up — VegaHealth flagged recurring latency misses during onboarding window, 7d p95 ~1.3s vs target 1.0s, p99 spikes to ~3.8s on 3 days. Renewal check-in next Tue. Need: evidence bundle, proposed credit calc, and an enablement plan before then.

javier_csm: ack. can you drop the dashboard + raw numbers here? i'll prep comms draft once we have numbers.

olivia_support: dashboard link: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/vegahealth/slo?range=7d
quick snapshot i pulled: uptime 99.96% (SLO 99.9) — uptime OK, latency is the blocker. p50=120ms, p95=1300ms, p99=3800ms. spikes clustered around 03/14, 03/16, 03/18 UTC.

emma_cs: thanks olivia. main ask from customer success: clean packet they can show internally (daily graphs + bullet summary) and a conservative credit proposal.

sarah_eng: pinging perf team — is this warm startup/kv-cache miss or a tail regression? i'll run the KV-hit and attention-kernel checks.

ryan_ops: FYI there was a small canary rollout to eu-west-1 yesterday, deploy-bot shows: "ops-bot: canary deploy finished 1798880100 — rollout=backend-model-v2 -> 10%". might correlate.

ops-bot: canary deploy finished 1798880100 — backend-model-v2 -> 10% (eu-west-1) :rocket:

sarah_eng: running query now, sharing snippet i used for the p95/p99 numbers: 
```
SELECT
  quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95,
  quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99,
  avg(latency_ms) AS mean
FROM redwood.request_metrics
WHERE customer_id = 'vegahealth' AND time >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', time)
ORDER BY date_trunc('day', time)
```
will attach CSV and traces after run.

javier_csm: customer contact is @marie. she asked for a single-page summary + the raw CSV for their audit. i'll own external comms if we hand me the artifacts.

raj_sales: agree with conservative tone. recommend: 1) show numbers + timeline, 2) summarize root-cause investigation status, 3) offer pro-rated credit formula and remediation plan. avoid internal blame/engineering details.

olivia_support: draft credit calc i started (will refine): "credit = min(monthly_invoice, monthly_invoice * clamp( (p95_excess_pct / 0.1) * 0.03, 0, 0.15))" — basically 3% of invoice per 0.1% SLO breach capped at 15%. open to edits. i'll attach spreadsheet.

sarah_eng: initial findings: p99 spikes line up with higher tail latencies during cache cold windows and two heavy retries. i see a subtle increase in model tokenization time after the v2 kernel change. i'll validate with flamegraphs.

ryan_ops: ops will run a backfill of traces for the three spike days and attach flamegraphs + service logs. adding an alert rule for customer-specific p95>1s so we catch earlier.

olivia_support: plan: i'll assemble the bundle — 1-pg summary, 7d graphs, CSV, credit calc spreadsheet, incident timestamps, and a short remediation note. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

emma_cs: perfect. action owners: @olivia -> evidence bundle, @sarah -> root cause + flamegraphs, @ryan -> backfill traces + alert, @raj -> draft customer comms and renewal negotiation framing, @javier -> coordinate with Marie. i'll collate and put into the renewal playbook.

raj_sales: will draft comms after olivia shares artifacts. propose offering a one-month credit cap or invoice offset as part of renewal to reduce churn risk.

javier_csm: quick Q — do we need legal signoff on the credit formula? maybe for anything >5% of invoice.

omelia_support: (typo) meant to say olivia_support: yes, cc legal if we go over 5%.

sarah_eng: one more thing — if it's tied to canary rollout, we can propose a targeted performance tune + dedicated perf run for VegaHealth in their pre-prod window. that helps in the comms.

emma_cs: love that. ok folks — let's keep updates in this thread. i'll set a short standby huddle for EOD tomorrow if artifacts are ready. :thumbsup:

olivia_support: attaching ETA to thread: will post CSV + draft summary by 10:00 AM tomorrow.

ops-bot: alert created: rule "vegahealth_p95_alert" -> notify #eng-oncall + #customer-success when p95 > 1000ms for 5m.

ryan_ops: backfill started. will link traces when done.

emma_cs: thanks team — closing loop for now, will follow up with huddle invite if we need synchronous review. :white_check_mark:
